label: baseline
description: Two-activity walk under tests/fixtures/token-bench, one activity at each end of the size scale, against a meta namespace standing in for the role contract every delivery carries. Engine CI gates delivery against this fixture; a work-package character-count belongs on the corpus tree under walks/. `activityDeliveries` splits each delivery into the role contract and the body that varies with the activity, so a change that moves one share is not mistaken for one that moves the other.
